panels.title: Known peers
panels.description: This panel shows the peers the node currently has in its roster, reachable or not.

panels.title: Reachable peers
panels.description: This panel shows the known peers that the node can reach. The node has confirmed each one.

panels.title: Vault used
panels.description: This panel shows the vault space used as a fraction of the quota.

panels.title: Failed request share (5m)
panels.description: This panel shows the percent of HTTP responses with a 5xx status. It covers the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Request rate by endpoint
panels.description: This panel shows the requests per second for each endpoint.

panels.title: Failed request rate by endpoint
panels.description: This panel shows the 5xx responses per second for each endpoint.

panels.title: Request latency across endpoints
panels.description: This panel shows the p50, p95, and p99 request duration for all endpoints together.

panels.title: Used vs quota
panels.description: This panel shows the vault space used against the configured quota. A gap in the used series means the reading was unavailable, not that the vault was empty.

panels.title: Discarded writes
panels.description: This panel shows the writes the node discarded, and who is answerable for each. Any band means the node lost a write.

panels.title: Write transaction rate
panels.description: This panel shows the write transactions that open per second. A write refused before the transaction opened is absent here. Discarded writes reports it.

panels.title: Reads in flight
panels.description: This panel shows the reads open through the vault.

panels.title: Write begin latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: This panel shows the time to begin a write transaction. A rising p50 is sustained contention. A flat p50 under a rising p99 is an occasional pile-up.

panels.title: Write execute latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: This panel shows the time a module spends reading and writing inside the transaction.

panels.title: Write commit latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: This panel shows the time to commit a write transaction. A rolled-back transaction is absent here.

panels.title: Entries, by collection
panels.description: This panel shows the entries each collection holds.

panels.title: Eviction throughput
panels.description: This panel shows the URLs and postings that storage eviction purges per second.

panels.title: Eviction failures
panels.description: This panel shows when eviction sweeps end in error.

panels.title: Peers accepting remote index, by ring sector
panels.description: This panel shows the DHT ring unrolled: each row is one sector of the keyspace, and a dark row is a sector with no peer to offer postings to.

panels.title: Ring sectors with no accepting peer
Ring fraction from a posting to the peer that accepted its replica
panels.description: This panel shows how far around the ring accepted replicas land from the DHT position of the posting.

panels.title: Ring fraction from a posting to the peer that accepted its replica (p50/p95)
Distribution cycles skipped
panels.description: This panel shows the distribution cycles that offered nothing, by reason.

panels.title: Posting offer acceptance rate
panels.description: This panel shows the share of posting offers that peers accept.

panels.title: Longest offer lateness
panels.description: This panel shows how far past its scheduled time the most overdue posting offer is.

panels.title: Posting offers sent, by outcome
panels.description: This panel shows posting offers sent to peers, grouped by outcome.

panels.title: Postings offered, by outcome
panels.description: This panel shows postings sent to peers per second, grouped by the outcome of the offer that carried them.

panels.title: URL metadata deliveries sent, by outcome
panels.description: This panel shows URL metadata delivery requests sent to peers, grouped by outcome.

panels.title: URLs delivered as metadata, by outcome
panels.description: This panel shows URLs delivered to peers as metadata per second, grouped by the outcome of the delivery that carried them.

panels.title: Postings on the offer schedule
panels.description: This panel shows how many postings hold a due entry on the offer schedule.

panels.title: Postings handed off to closer peers
panels.description: This panel shows postings deleted after peers closer to their DHT position accepted them.

panels.title: Replicas dropped from peers
panels.description: This panel shows replicas dropped because closer peers displaced the holder, or the holder stayed uncontacted past the credibility window.

panels.title: Postings evicted mid-cycle
panels.description: This panel shows due postings that left the index before the cycle could read them for offering.

panels.title: Posting escrow throughput
panels.description: This panel shows the inbound postings held for their URL metadata, released into the index when it arrives, and dropped when it never does.

panels.title: Posting escrow occupancy
panels.description: This panel shows the held postings as a fraction of the escrow capacity. The escrow refuses new postings at 100 percent.

panels.title: Held postings never claimed
panels.description: This panel shows the share of held postings dropped because their URL metadata never arrived.

panels.title: Posting escrow refusals
panels.description: This panel shows when the escrow drops inbound postings because it is at capacity.

panels.title: Posting escrow expiry failures
panels.description: This panel shows when held posting expiry runs end in error.
